sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to surgical informed consent questions

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT informed consent responses (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kinkaid Grade Level for all responses was 17.5 (SD, 2.1), a postgraduate reading level.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kinkaid Grade Level score for all responses was 17.5 (SD, 2.1), corresponding to a postgraduate reading level.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility of AI-generated informed consent content for patients via reading level
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kinkaid Grade Level 17.5 (SD 2.1), postgraduate level, far above typical patient literacy.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kinkaid Grade Level score for all responses was 17.5 (SD, 2.1), corresponding to a postgraduate reading level.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-generated informed consent responses rated by expert physicians
links.effect: 44.0% correct and adequate; 22.6% correct but insufficient; 29.8% accurate and misleading together; 3.6% wrong or irrelevant.
links.quote: However, it produced clearly false portions of responses, highlighting the need for a careful review of responses by qualified health care professionals.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 generated informed consent information for urogynecological surgeries using physician reviewers and readability formulas, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
